redCandidate.setup: Persist and reload a real two-feature Rex ledger in a temporary AIOS root, then run one adapter iteration with real F1 receipt evidence.
redCandidate.expected: The only callback context is the non-semantic delivery ID and Rex's persisted F1 continue decision; no ledger is exposed before Rex evaluates evidence.
redCandidate.observed: The callback context contains the complete rehydrated Rex ledger in addition to the delivery ID and F1 decision.
redCandidate.failureReason: The adapter leaks mutable persisted Rex state to the host callback, allowing host-side mutation before the Rex domain transition.
